biotools.summary: Flexiplex is a versatile demultiplexer and search tool designed for omics data, particularly useful for analyzing long-read single-cell RNA-Seq data by allowing imperfect matches through Levenshtein distance. It allows flexible error tolerance during barcode assignment and target sequence identification.
